newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi, Berisha discuss Albanian crisis.
newsitem.headline: Prodi, Berisha discuss Albanian crisis.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi told Albanian President Sali Berisha in a telephone conversation on Monday that he hoped a political solution could be found to the crisis in Albania.
Prodi's office said in a statement that it was the second time in as many days that the Italian leader and Berisha had discussed the situation in Albania by phone.
"Prodi said again that he firmly hoped for a political solution to the current crisis," the statement said.
Italy fears that a continuing crisis in the small Balkan country could lead to a new mass exodus of Albanians across the southern Adriatic.
Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini has called for a European Union meeting on Albania.
Italian helicopters evacutated some 35 foreigners and Albanians from the south of the country earlier on Monday.
